articles.title: Can a husband gift cash to his wife without triggering a tax demand? ITAT examines ₹58 lakh bank deposits
articles.summary: The Delhi tribunal has directed the income-tax department to re-examine whether ₹58.07 lakh deposited by a woman came from cash withdrawn by her husband after the sale of agricultural land. The ruling highlights the importance of maintaining documentary evidence for large family transfers.

articles.title: Can the income-tax department tax your GST refund? ITAT rules in favour of taxpayer, explains when it is not taxable
articles.summary: A Delhi ITAT ruling has held that a GST refund cannot automatically be treated as taxable income merely because it appears in the tax audit report. The decision offers relief to businesses whose GST payments were not claimed as expenses.

articles.title: ESIC rules eased: No separate claims needed for sickness, maternity benefits; check payout deadlines
articles.summary: The Employees' State Insurance (General) Regulations, 2026 came into force on November 21, replacing rules introduced in 1950; eligible insured employees can receive benefits through direct payments.
